text: Welcome.
If an urge has brought you here, you can take this moment at your own pace.
You can pause, move, or open your eyes whenever you need.
Find a position where your body has enough support.
Let your hands rest wherever they are comfortable.
Notice the places where your body meets the chair or floor.
Feel your feet, or another point of contact with the ground.
You can close your eyes or keep them softly open.
Notice your breathing just as it is.
You do not need to deepen or change it.
Notice the weight of your hands resting.
Let your attention rest with that feeling.
Feel the support beneath your body.
For these next few moments, nothing needs to be worked out.
If an urge is here, notice where you feel it.
If there isn't an urge now, you can stay with the feeling of your body resting.
Notice that feeling as gently as you can.
What do you notice? A little tension. Restlessness. Or something else.
Let your breathing find its own rhythm.
You can feel the support beneath you at the same time.
Let the room be part of your awareness, too.
You can take a moment before choosing what to do next.
What would help you through this moment?
It might be a step from your quit plan, or reaching out to someone.
Let your attention widen to your whole body again.
Feel the support beneath you.
Notice one detail in the room.
When you are ready, open your eyes or let your gaze return.
Welcome back.
Be gentle with yourself today.
